records.title: PROGRESS UNDER PMEGP
details:
Under Scheme of Fund for Regeneration of Traditional Industries (SFURTI), 20 clusters have
been approved in the State of Rajasthan in handicrafts, stone sculpture and textile industries sectors out of
which 16 are functional and 4 clusters are under implementation.
